parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: The slider is a small plastic lever located on the side of the toaster, used to lower and raise the bread carriage.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the internal heating mechanism and timer when pressed down, and releases when the toasting cycle is complete.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically along a guided slot, typically spring-loaded to return to its original position after use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main housing of the toaster, made of stainless steel for durability and heat resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the heating elements, electrical components, and provides structural support for the entire appliance.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed frame for all other moving parts.
